POWER_HOUR_EXPLOSION: The stock price must be between $0.50 and $15.00. The Average Daily Volume (ADV) of the preceding 5 trading days must be at least 50,000,000 shares. From market open (9:30 AM EST) until 2:00 PM EST, the cumulative volume must be at least 1000x the average 1-minute volume of the preceding 5 trading days' regular market sessions, AND a minimum of 500,000,000 shares. During this pre-consolidation period, the stock must exhibit a clear, controlled uptrend; the highest price reached is at least 15% above PDC, but no more than 40% above PDC. The VWAP must maintain a consistent upward slope, with the 2:00 PM EST VWAP being at least 10% above PDC. There must be no single 1-minute candle exceeding 5% of its preceding 5-minute average price range. Net market order flow (buy volume minus sell volume) must constitute at least 60% of the total cumulative volume during this period, with an average trade size of aggressive market buys of at least 350,000 shares. A deep consolidation period must occur between 2:00 PM EST and 3:00 PM EST (60 minutes). During this consolidation, the price must trade within an extremely tight range, no greater than 0.75% of its midpoint price. Volume must contract drastically: the average 1-minute volume during this consolidation must be no more than 0.5% of the average 1-minute volume from 9:30 AM - 2:00 PM EST, AND a maximum of 50,000 shares per minute. The low of this consolidation period must not breach the day's VWAP (calculated from 9:30 AM - 2:00 PM EST), the previous hour's VWAP, AND must hold the 9-period Exponential Moving Average, the 20-period Simple Moving Average, the 50-period Simple Moving Average, AND the 200-period Simple Moving Average (all 1-minute chart); additionally, the Vortex Indicator (VI+) must remain above VI- on the 1-minute chart. The lowest price during consolidation must also be at least 15% above the PDC, ensuring previous accumulation strength. Volume profile must show a clearly defined Volume-at-Price (VAP) node forming at or immediately below the consolidation low, representing significant demand absorption. The breakout must occur between 3:00 PM EST and 3:10 PM EST (the first 10 minutes of the 'Power Hour'). The first 1-minute candle that breaches the consolidation high must have volume at least 500x the average 1-minute volume of the consolidation period, AND a minimum of 50,000,000 shares. This breakout candle must close at least 10% above the consolidation high and within the upper 90% of its own range. Cumulative volume during these 10 minutes must exceed 1500x the average 1-minute volume of the preceding 5 trading days' regular market sessions, AND be a minimum of 400,000,000 shares. After these 10 minutes, the price must be at least 30% above the consolidation high, maintaining aggressive upward momentum without significant pullbacks (no 1-minute candle closing below its open by more than 0.5% of the consolidation range). Time & Sales data for the first 5 minutes of the breakout must show greater than 90% aggressive market buy orders, with an average trade size of at least 750,000 shares, and a cumulative delta of at least 80% of total volume. For the remaining 50 minutes of the Power Hour (3:10 PM - 4:00 PM EST), the price must continue to appreciate rapidly or consolidate extremely tightly (within a 0.25% range) above the highest point reached during the initial 10 minutes of the Power Hour, never retesting the consolidation high, and any pullbacks must be shallow and temporary, immediately followed by new highs. At least 95% of 1-minute candles during this period must be green, closing above their open, with any red candles being extremely shallow pullbacks (not exceeding 0.1% of the preceding green candle's range) on significantly lower volume (less than 5% of the preceding 5-minute average volume). The average 1-minute volume during this period must be at least 75% of the average 1-minute volume of the initial 10-minute breakout period (3:00-3:10 PM EST), AND a minimum of 30,000,000 shares per minute. Cumulative volume during this 50-minute period must be at least 1200x the average 1-minute volume of the preceding 5 trading days' regular market sessions, AND a minimum of 1,200,000,000 shares. The closing price must be within the upper 99% of the Power Hour's range (3:00 PM - 4:00 PM EST high-low) and within the upper 95% of the entire day's range. By the end of the trading day, the total daily volume must exceed 2000x the average 1-minute volume of the preceding 5 trading days' regular market sessions, AND be a minimum of 2,000,000,000 shares. The highest price reached during the entire day must be at least 500% above PDC, and the closing price must be at least 400% above PDC.
